items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Joe Hayman was the saxophone player, too; he was the alto player

ctx.x: Wasn't Joe Hayman with that band?
You're right. Joe Hayman was the saxophone player, too; he was the alto player -- and one of the White brothers was a tenor saxophone player.
Was that the first time you worked with Whetsol? In the White Brothers Band?
